title: ElytraHUD
description: Minimalist elytra HUD — durability, rockets, and flight speed at a glance. Fully customizable with a live preview.
body:
[![JOIN OUR DISCORD](https://img.shields.io/badge/JOIN%20OUR%20DISCORD-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/HTkn94BXmA)

A clean, minimalist HUD that keeps the one thing that matters while flying — how much elytra you have left — right where you can see it, without cluttering your screen. At a glance it shows your elytra durability, how many firework rockets you are carrying, and your current flight speed, all in a single compact row.

![Elytra HUD](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9a73c8e392bf402915267f16d505f6e7cfd2db0a_0.webp)

**Client-side only** (no server installation required). **Fully compatible with singleplayer and multiplayer**.

**Please report any bugs, errors, or feature suggestions on Discord:** [https://discord.gg/4XUPywnEyE](https://discord.gg/4XUPywnEyE)

**What it shows:**
- A live durability bar that smoothly shifts green → amber → red as your elytra wears down, with the remaining percentage or the exact value.
- A pulsing low-durability warning so you know when to land or swap wings (configurable threshold).
- Your firework rocket count (counts your inventory and your offhand).
- Your current flight speed.
- Real elytra and rocket item icons, drawn straight from the game.

**Fully customizable, with a live preview:**
- Choose when the HUD appears: Always, only When Equipped, or only While Gliding.
- Place it in any of six screen positions from a visual grid, with free offsets and 50–200% scaling.
- Toggle each element on or off (icon, bar, rockets, speed), and switch the durability text between percent, value, or hidden.
- Tune background opacity, color-by-durability, and the low-durability warning.
- Every change is reflected instantly in the in-settings preview — what you configure is exactly what you get in game.

**Usage:**
Open the settings screen with the `/elytrahud` command (alias `/ehud`) or a customizable hotkey. On NeoForge you can also open it from the in-game mod list.

**Details:**
- All settings are stored locally in your client config folder (`config/elytrahud.json`).
- Available for Fabric, NeoForge, and Forge across a wide range of Minecraft versions.
- Fully translated into 10 languages: English, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Brazilian Portuguese, Korean, and Italian.
